[color=#ffffff]This mod replaces BatteryPack, SolarEssence and VoidEssence, and adds some animation for them. If you don't want them animated, you can also download Non-Animated ones, which just replace the three items without animation.

[u][size=6]Install[/size][/u]
[/color][/size][list=1]
[*][size=4]Make sure ﻿[/size][size=4]you have installed latest versions of Content Patcher, Content Patcher Animations and SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/size]
[*][size=4]Dowload files which you need and unzip these files.[/size]
[*][size=4]Put the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder and load up the game. Have fun.[/size]
[/list][size=4][size=3]
[size=6][u]Config[/u]
[/size][/size][/size][size=4]There is a [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each item. Simply change "true" to "false".

The [size=4][color=#ffffff]SolarEssence[/color][/size] has 8 different colors versions(In the [size=4][color=#ffffff]Non-Animated ones[/color][/size], it has 7). They are red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple and rainbow. [color=#ffff00][b][u]You [/u][/b][u][b]can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/b][/u][/color][b][color=#ffff00].[/color] [/b](Default rainbow, in non-animation onces it's red)[b]

[code]﻿[/code][size=2]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[/b]此mod替换了电池组、太阳精华和虚空精华，并增加了动态效果。如果你不想要动态效果，你可以下载无动态效果版本，它仅仅是替换。

[size=6][u]安装[/u][/size]
1、你必须安装了最新版本的前置[size=4]Content Patcher, Content Patcher Animations 和 SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/size]
2、下载你需要的mod并解压
3、把它放入你的星露谷物语Mods文件夹内，启动游戏。玩得开心。

[u][size=6]控制文件[/size][/u]
解压后的文件夹内有一个[/size][size=4][size=4][i]config.json[/i][/size]文件，你可以控制物品是否替换。只要选择[size=4]"true"（替换） to "false"（不替换）[/size]。

太阳精华有8种不同颜色供选择（在无动态效果里是7种）。它们是红、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫和彩虹色。[color=#ffff00][b][u]在[size=4][i]config.json[/i][/size]文件里进行选择，不过在同一时间你只能选择其中一种颜色。[/u][/b][/color]（默认彩虹色，无动态效果默认红色）
[/size]
